label: Library Tweaks
Small tweaks for the native Zen Library. Each feature below toggles independently.
Features
Saves section (bookmarks)
Turning it off unregisters everything and restores native behavior immediately, no restart needed (the urlbar provider, once loaded, stays until restart).
Easels section

Lists the boards stored by the zen-easel mod in the native Zen Library, with search, open, rename and delete. Requires the zen-easel mod; without it the section shows an empty state. Toggling applies immediately, no restart needed.
Media section

Gathers images, video and audio from your Downloads folder, Zen Easel captures, Screenshots and optional extra folders (zen.library.media.user-dirs, semicolon-separated) into a masonry grid with type/location filters, previews and audio playback. Toggling applies immediately, no restart needed.
Sidebar
Drag sidebar tabs to rearrange sections
Drag any Library sidebar tab up or down to rearrange the sections. The arrangement is remembered across restarts. Turning this off locks the tabs in place.
Shortcuts
Ctrl+J (Cmd+J on macOS) smart-saves the page
Saves the current page with generated title and tags instead of opening the native bookmark panel. Off hands the key back to Firefox.
Ctrl+H (Cmd+H on macOS) opens Library History
Takes over the history shortcut so it opens the native Library on History instead of the Firefox sidebar. Off hands the key back.
History
Right-click menu on history items
Adds Copy, Forget About This Site and Delete to right-clicked history rows, like the classic library.
Boosts
Better Boosts presentation
Groups boosts under domain headers with large icon tiles and a strike-through on disabled boosts. Row behavior stays native.
Spaces
Drop position indicator
Shows an accent line at the exact drop position while dragging over spaces. Visual only; drops behave as native.
New space button
Adds a trailing + tile that opens workspace creation.
Re-apply workspace themes

Keeps space cards on the theme picker's latest gradient, primary and text colors — including complex multi-layer gradients — converging renders that raced theme loading. Same values native would set, so it is a no-op when already correct.

Complex space gradients need no toggle: the native section already passes theme gradient strings through, so richer gradients appear automatically when a gradient provider (e.g. BetterZenGradientPicker) supplies them.
Downloads
Also show files from the Downloads folder

Appends an On this device group with top-level files and folders from your Downloads folder that are not in download history (hidden and partial files skipped). The folder is read off the main thread in small chunks.
Rename files from the menu
Adds Rename file to the download context menus. File icons already resolve from the OS exactly like the classic library, so there is nothing to toggle there.
Grey out moved or missing files
Dims download rows whose files are gone from disk. Moved or missing files are also excluded from renaming, so no stray divider is left behind.
Animation
Animate section switches
Fades and rises incoming sections when switching tabs, using the classic easing. Respects reduced-motion settings.
